$comment: The source of sf-change's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js), in the 1.4 form (scripts/generate-component-files.mjs writes rule.js, studio.fixture.json, studio.scenario.json, probe.json and smart.manifest.json from it). A new component, made against standard simai.smart-component 1.3.15 and vocabulary 1.1.5: owner decision C40 (2026-11-09; research ui-control control/research/2026-11-09-timeline-parts.md §5, prototype prototypes/timeline-parts.html#change).

before.summary: The value as it was, text. Empty reads «пусто»

after.summary: The value as it became, text. Empty reads «пусто»

label.summary: The field's name («Статус»). Printed before the pair only with show-label; in layout list each change's own label is its term

show-label.summary: Print «Статус: » before the pair -- a table cell, a notification; off inside a sentence that already names the field

changes.summary: The changes of one update, each {label, before, after}, for layout list: a property, the JSON island a server prints, or the changes attribute as JSON (markup). A number is shown as its text; null or empty reads «пусто». In layout inline without before and after, the first change is the pair

layout.summary: inline: «Собран → Передан в доставку» inside a sentence, the arrow and the new value never break apart; list: a description list, the labels' column and the pairs, stacked under a 24rem container

reveal.summary: auto: in layout inline, a value longer than 80 characters is not put in the sentence; «Показать изменения» reveals the two values as blocks («Было», «Стало») in place; none: always the pair

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: The arrow is a picture (aria-hidden); a visually hidden word between the values says the change («Собран на Передан в доставку», «… to …»). Layout list is a dl: the label the term, the pair its description. The reveal is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls naming the blocks; the blocks say «Было» and «Стало» in words. An empty value says «пусто».

x-summary: A field change as text: «Собран → Передан в доставку», the old value quiet, the new one in the text colour and medium weight, no badges and no strikethrough; inline in a sentence, as a list of several fields, or, for a long text, revealed in place as «Было» and «Стало».

x-source.brief: Owner decision C40 (2026-11-09, decisions.md row C40): a new sf-change, «было → стало» as text, inline and as a list; sf-confirm-change draws its list with it. The data {label, before, after} is the model sf-confirm-change already takes (research timeline-parts §4). Not now: a colour per stage value (a later tone setting).

x-decisions: name: sf-change, family text (C40). The tag says what it shows; sf-confirm-change (alias sf-change-confirm until 2027-01-01) asks for a change and draws its list with this one.

look (C40, R092): the old value in on-surface-variant, the arrow «→» the same and aria-hidden, the new value in on-surface and medium weight; no badges (two boxes in a line are noise) and no strikethrough (it reads as an error or a deletion). An empty value is the word «пусто», italic and quiet, as sf-confirm-change said it.

inline: the label with show-label («Статус: »), the old value, then the arrow glued to the new value's first word by a no-break space, so the arrow never ends a line; both values wrap like the sentence (overflow-wrap anywhere) and never pass the container's edge. A visually hidden word («на», «to») between the values.

list: a dl on one grid: the labels' column as wide as the longest label (max-content), the pairs beside it; under a 24rem container (container query on the host) the label stands over its pair. A value in the list wraps.

reveal: in layout inline a before or after longer than 80 characters (Array.from, so a grapheme is not cut) is not put in the sentence; a link-coloured button «Показать изменения» (aria-expanded, aria-controls) reveals the two values in place as outlined blocks labelled «Было» and «Стало», the old one quiet; «Скрыть изменения» hides them. The state is the element's own; a redraw keeps it.
type: the place's own -- the element inherits the font and the line, so it reads right in a sentence of any size; the reveal's button and the blocks' labels are one step down (text 1/2).

css-variables: six public variables (§6) -- the old value's colour, the new value's colour and weight, the arrow's colour, the labels' colour and the list's column gap -- listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json; the Framework never sets one.

version 1.0.1 (2026-11-11, C40 follow-up, acceptance note 1, dispatcher decision): a patch, a small look fix. A value of up to 20 characters (a number and its unit «4,6 кг», a phone number «+7 900 000-00-00», a name) stays whole on one line (.sf-change__whole, white-space nowrap), in a sentence and in a list; only a longer value wraps (overflow-wrap anywhere, as 1.0.0). At 390 1.0.0 read «4,6 / кг», «+7 900 / 000-00-00». Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: deciding what changed (the host gives before and after)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-change wherever a field's change is said: a timeline event, an audit log column, a notification «Статус: Собран → В пути», a confirmation of an edit, a version history.
do_not: Do not draw the values as badges or strike the old one out
Do not put markup in before or after; they are text
Do not use it to ask for a change; sf-confirm-change does that

keyboard: Tab reaches «Показать изменения» when a long value is folded; Enter or Space reveals or hides the values
accessibility.focus: Only the reveal's button takes focus.
